title: Hoods & Ducts - Buckley SFB
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > FA2543  460 CONS

files.name: Performance Work Statement (PWS) Hood and Ducts 7 Jul 2026 Draft.pdf

description:
DESCRIPTION OF SERVICES. The contractor shall provide all management, tools, supplies, equipment and labor necessary to ensure that commercial hood and duct cleaning services are performed at Buckley Space Force Base, Colorado, in a manner that will ensure continuous and safe operation of such systems and prevent any potential grease fire from spreading past the cook-line into the hood and ductwork. All cleaning shall be in accordance with the most current version of the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 96, (Standard for Ventilation Control and Fire Protection of Commercial Cooking Operations), Air Force Instruction (AFI) 91-203, para 44.3.6.5, and all other local, state, and federal rules and procedures. This will be an agreement tentatively for a base year plus four option years. This does not obligate the Government to exercise additional options. The scope of this contract is limited to cleaning and inspection. The contractor shall report any deficiencies requiring repair (e.g., worn bearings, system leaks, motor failures) to the COR, but is not authorized to perform repairs under this PWS. 

 *SEE ATTACHED PWS
